agentlink.title: AgentLink
agentlink.not_configured_hint: Set HH_AGENTLINK_URL so ask_agent can route between agents.

backup.title: System Backup
backup.description: Full backup of database, configs and user workspaces. For catastrophe recovery and server migration.
backup.restore_warning: File: {{file}}. Current state will be auto-saved as rollback. Service will restart after restore.
backup.waiting_restart: Restore applied — waiting for service restart…
backup.restore_done: Restore complete. Please log in again.

migration.title: Server Migration (Full Clone)
migration.description: Transfers ALL data via rsync to a freshly installed HydraHive2 server — including projects, Git repos, workspaces, VMs and disk archives. Incremental and resumable.
migration.warning: The target server must have a freshly installed HydraHive2. ALL data there will be overwritten with this server's data. The target service is stopped during transfer and restarted afterwards.
migration.running: Transfer in progress — this may take hours for large data sets…
migration.success: Migration completed successfully. The target server is a 1:1 clone.

tailscale.title: Tailscale
tailscale.install_hint: Installs the Tailscale binary and enables tailscaled. Connect here afterwards with an auth key.
tailscale.authkey_hint: Create an auth key in the Tailscale admin panel:
tailscale.login_open_hint: Open this link and sign in with your Tailscale account. The card picks up the connection on its own.
tailscale.invite_explainer: Generates a one-time auth key (valid 24h) for another server. Requires a Tailscale admin API key configured below.
tailscale.invite_failed: Auth key could not be generated
tailscale.admin_api_key_hint: From the Tailscale admin panel → Settings → Keys → API access tokens.
tailscale.admin_tailnet_hint: '-' uses your own tailnet. Otherwise the tailnet name (e.g. example.com).
tailscale.admin_save_failed: API key was rejected by Tailscale

samba.title: SMB Shares (Samba)
samba.subtitle: Project workspaces as network shares — mountable from Windows/Mac/Linux.
samba.done: Samba running. Enable per-project via the project's settings tab.

bridge.title: Network bridge (br0)
bridge.subtitle: Bridged networking for VMs and containers — same IP range as the host.
bridge.confirm_hint: Setup changes the netplan config and runs `netplan apply` — network may drop for ~10 seconds. SSH sessions might hang but recover.
bridge.done: Bridge set up — VMs/containers now have LAN access.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Integration settings without SSH. The SearXNG URL takes effect immediately; integrations like Mail/Discord/AgentLink require a backend restart.

local_media.title: Local image/video generation
local_media.subtitle: ComfyUI on your own NVIDIA GPU: images (SDXL) and videos (Wan 2.1) without cloud costs.

blocked.vram_too_small: Blocked: the GPU does not have enough VRAM. At least {{min}} GB are required.
blocked.disk_too_small: Blocked: not enough free disk space ({{free}} free, {{need}} required).

local_media.confirm_install: Install now? About {{size}} of models will be downloaded ({{free}} free).
local_media.confirm_install_hint: Depending on your connection this can take an hour or more. HydraHive stays usable meanwhile.
local_media.confirm_uninstall_hint: Container, models (~{{size}}) and the “Local GPU” backend are deleted. Default models pointing to it are reset. Docker itself stays.
local_media.done_install: Installed. The local models are now available for image and video.
local_media.done_uninstall: Removed. Updates will not reinstall it.

addons.title: Add-on modules
addons.subtitle: Anything outside the core can be installed here. Updates will then maintain these modules as well.
addons.hint_wsl: Usually not available under WSL (no KVM/systemd networking).
addons.hint_mac: Not available on a Mac (requires Linux).
addons.confirm_restart: HydraHive restarts briefly. The page keeps following afterwards.
addons.failed: Installation failed – see the log for details.

desc.containers: Agents can create and work inside their own Linux containers.
desc.vms: Full virtual machines with a screen in the browser.
desc.samba: Project folders as a network drive on your LAN.
desc.voice: Local speech recognition and speech output (runs in a container).
desc.tailscale: Secure access on the go through your own tailnet.
